similarity_score_transformation.monotonicity: Larger values strictly indicate greater semantic vector alignment

findings.title: Physical Location of Bridge Runner in RAG Package
findings.reproducible_evidence: Audit prompt references backend/app/mcp_server/bridge_runner.py, but file is located at backend/app/rag/bridge_runner.py.
findings.impact: None. Structurally cleaner to keep bridge_runner in backend.app.rag where Phase 3 imports reside.
findings.recommended_remediation: Document path explicitly in audit reports and architecture references.

findings.title: Derived Cosine Similarity Semantics Accurately Documented
findings.reproducible_evidence: derived_sim = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - raw_dist_float)) is accurately described as derived cosine similarity score, not probability.
findings.impact: Positive. Prevents hallucinated or misattributed statistical confidence.
findings.recommended_remediation: Maintain consistent wording in future agent prompt templates.

findings.title: Subprocess Cold-Start Latency for On-Demand CPU Retrieval
findings.reproducible_evidence: Subprocess execution takes ~9.8s to 10.5s per retrieval call due to PyTorch and BGE model loading on CPU.
findings.impact: Guarantees complete memory isolation and stream hygiene, but is noticeable in interactive multi-turn loops.
findings.recommended_remediation: Acceptable for Phase 4 tool integration. Consider persistent worker daemon in future production hardening.

findings.title: Single-Line JSON Protocol Safely Rejects Extraneous Output
findings.reproducible_evidence: json.loads(stdout_text) raises JSONDecodeError on any extra data or multi-line stdout, triggering RAGBridgeProcessError.
findings.impact: Positive. Prevents corrupted or partial data from entering tool responses.
findings.recommended_remediation: Preserve strict single-line JSON parsing pattern.

findings.title: Windows Loopback Socket Creation in Standard Sandbox Mode
findings.reproducible_evidence: Real stdio subprocess lifecycle tests on Windows require loopback socket creation; standard sandbox mode blocks self-pipes, requiring elevated execution.
findings.impact: None on runtime production deployment; verified passing under BypassSandbox: true.
findings.recommended_remediation: Document Windows loopback testing requirements in test documentation.
